feature_contract.goal: Eliminate unnecessary synchronous D3D9 R13 effect-state readback for depth-disabled translucent stereo draws while preserving the exact depth-on R27 world probe and fail-closed mono/recovery behavior.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R29 cached depth-off world exception eligibility, not R27 classifier, shader WVP, HUD, SkyGlow, DirectGPU, FFB or any DX11/DXVK branch.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: R29's generation-fenced six-field cached effect says Z disabled, whereas R27ShouldBypassLegacyZeroDisparity requires a fresh R13 snapshot proving depth enabled; before this patch every fragile alpha/sand/flare draw could still request five live render-state getters only to return false. Improvement is workload-dependent, not an HMD FPS measurement.
trace_stages: Original game alpha/smoke/sand depth-disabled Draw enters R29 state-cached stereo guard.
R29 effect state synchronizes six D3D9 fields and chooses direct left+right or legacy R13 fallback; depth-off R27 live snapshot redundantly reads states.
Both eyes render through unchanged R29DirectTwoEye and original OpenXR compositor; depth-enabled WorldBillboard maintains validated R27 recheck.
subcomponents: Skip first semantic corroborated R27 probe for generation-synchronized depth-disabled Draw while preserving the force-zero veto.
Skip second generic R27 probe on the same no-depth state, leaving depth-enabled strict R27 and recovery/legacy fail-closed routes intact.
Install an exact-SHA 16-case and destructive-mutation verifier before Windows host/game/package integration.

Depth-tested effects retain original positive R27 probe; forced zero, failed sync, StateBlock changes and legacy fail-closed behavior are unchanged.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Original source R29GuardStableDraw calls R27ShouldBypassLegacyZeroDisparity in both semantic/generic branches for fragile depth-off draws, even though R27 hard-rejects !effect.zEnabled.
source_trace: R29SyncEffectState reads cached ZENABLE inside tracked StateBlock generation.
R29GuardStableDraw evaluates cached fragility then calls the no-snapshot R27 overload.
R27 no-snapshot overload captures five D3D9 render states, rejects !zEnabled, and cannot promote zero-depth effects to world stereo.
diagnosis.root_cause: Redundant independent live sampling after a fully synchronized depth-disabled result was already known, with no possible affirmative R27 classification for that state.
alternatives_rejected: Skipping the R27 gate for depth-enabled world sprites could break spatially anchored cutouts and is rejected.
Bypassing R29 mono/recovery fallback or forced-semantic zero would risk HMD safety and is rejected.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Two original positive R27 paths remain behind an R29 synchronized ZENABLE candidate guard; both-eye rendering and legacy fallbacks are unchanged.
